persons.name: Gaurigiri
persons.evidence: likhitaṃ śrīgosāiṃ suphalagirakā śiṣya gaurigiraka hastaṃ

place.as_written: nepāladeśe || paśupati vāgmatyāṃ pūrvakauśikāyāṃ paścimabhāge || bhagatapaṭane || harikṣetre || śrī 3 gurudattātrayasthāne || śrī 3 viśveśvarasannidhāne

notes: The manuscript contains multiple texts with separate dates, all written in VS 1893 by Gaurigiri, disciple of Gosāiṃ Suphalagiri at the Dattātreya temple in Bhaktapur: Viṣṇusahasranāma dated Āśvina vadi 1 roja 1; Bhīṣmastavarāja dated Āśvina vadi 4 roja 4; Bhagavadgītā dated Bhādra śudi 8 roja 1.
